facts.claim: Seven Seas Voyager (Regent Seven Seas Cruises): Entered service 2003; 42,363 GT; 700 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 204 m length; Voyager class.
Seven Seas Voyager is a cruise ship for Regent Seven Seas Cruises headquartered in Miami, Florida.
In 2006, a Forbes article listed the Asia leg of the Voyager's world cruise as the most expensive cruise in the Asia region.
